_doc: Sprite Factory: el héroe animado por capas. Aquí se dice quién es, qué animaciones tiene (con su hoja base de ejemplo y el prompt que la describe), cómo se coloca la espada y qué se exige a una hoja vestida.

hero.who: young knight in steel plate armour with a long dark blue hooded cape, messy brown hair
hero._anchor_doc: El héroe canónico, de lado y sin arma: la referencia de identidad de toda hoja nueva.

marker: In his right hand he holds a plain, perfectly straight, thin, solid bright MAGENTA (#FF00FF) rod about as long as his arm, instead of a sword (it is a placeholder: flat magenta, no shading, no outline)

walk.label: Caminar
walk.action: a 4-frame looping WALK cycle to the right, walking in place, upright relaxed posture, torso and head at the same height and angle in every frame; only the legs and arms change. {marker}, hanging low at his side, pointing forward and slightly down, held at the same angle in every frame. Frame 1: contact, RIGHT leg forward with the heel touching, LEFT leg back, widest stride. Frame 2: passing, legs close together under the body, left foot lifting past the right knee. Frame 3: contact, LEFT leg forward, RIGHT leg back, widest stride (the mirror of frame 1). Frame 4: passing, legs close together, right foot lifting past the left knee

attack.label: Atacar
attack.action: a one-handed overhead sword strike. {marker}. Frame 1: ready stance, knees slightly bent, rod held low and forward. Frame 2: wind-up, arm raised high, rod pointing up and back over the shoulder. Frame 3: the strike, front foot stepping forward, arm fully extended forward, rod swinging down pointing forward. Frame 4: follow-through, body leaning forward, arm low, rod pointing down and forward near the ground

cast.label: Lanzar habilidad
cast.action: channelling a spell THROUGH the weapon, strict side view facing right in all four frames (never facing the viewer); no magic effects are drawn (no fire, no glow, no particles): only the body pose. {marker}; the rod is clearly visible in EVERY frame. Frame 1: ready stance side view, feet apart, rod held low pointing forward and down. Frame 2: he lifts the rod upright in front of his chest, pointing straight up, elbow bent, head slightly bowed (gathering power). Frame 3: release: arm thrust fully forward at shoulder height, the rod pointing straight forward to the right, horizontal, body leaning into it, front knee bent. Frame 4: recovery: arm lowering, rod pointing forward and down, body upright
cast._doc: Primer intento (la mano libre lanzando y el palo quieto): salió de frente, con rayas de cuadrícula y sin palo en dos fotogramas. Canalizar por el arma mantiene el palo a la vista en los cuatro.

idle._doc: El reposo no se dibuja: es este fotograma (de pie, piernas juntas) respirando por código.

sword._doc: length: largo de la espada respecto a la altura del héroe de pie · grip: dónde se agarra (parte del largo, desde el pomo) · fist: radio del puño que se repinta encima de la empuñadura.

qa._doc: Lo que se exige a una hoja vestida frente a su base: giro del arma (grados), altura de la mano sobre los pies y altura del héroe (parte de su altura), y que ningún fotograma lleve un color que los demás no llevan. attempts: cuántas veces se intenta generar antes de dejarla marcada «para revisar». outfit: cuánto pueden diferir los colores de la ropa entre dos animaciones de la misma armadura.
